Interface 0 was claimed at open, so libusb's HANDLE_VALID guard (windows_winusb.c:3415) cannot have skipped the call. A real reset was requested on a capable driver, but the DFU state read the same before and after, so the effect is UNVERIFIED: a delivered port reset does not cycle VBUS, so an already-idle machine looks unchanged, which is indistinguishable here from a pipe cycle. Not success; not failure. To settle it, drive the machine into manifestWaitReset first (that is what stage_reset does) and reset again — then the transition is decisive.
